claims.subject: fixed-public-datasets
claims.statement: Akira was cross-checked against all fixed public datasets; result=matched.
claims.verification_rationale: Matched datasets: microsoft-threat-actor-mapping, misp-microsoft-activity-group, misp-mitre-intrusion-set, misp-threat-actor.
